narrativeProgression.description: Johnny Madrid enters the saloon and silently stares down the men.
The music swells, and a standoff develops as both sides consider their next move.
Johnny taunts the saloon leader, implying he knows they took the water and making a veiled threat about making him a 'good dog.'
Johnny throws the water at the leader, catching him off guard. He outsmarts the group by pointing out they are now 'dead' because they were splashed with 'holy water.'

youtube_description:
A scene from the pilot episode of Lancer (1968), titled 'The High Riders', which serves as inspiration for the Leonardo DiCaprio day-on-set scene from Quentin Tarantino's 'Once Upon A Time... In Hollywood'. 

All Rights CBS. 

Although Tarantino gets certain aspects dead on (i.e the episode was directed by Sam Wanamaker) he liberally rewrites the dialogue and presents the scene as it would have happened with fictional 50's Wrestern TV star Rick Dalton.
